saved:swimming.said: I started swimming classes this week and the first one went well. Any tips for breathing?
saved: [daily] On 28 September 2026, the owner started swimming classes this week, and their first class went well.
saved:swimming.reply:
A few cues that help:

- Exhale steadily underwater instead of holding your breath.
- Turn your head with your body to inhale; keep one goggle underwater and avoid lifting your head.
- Make the inhale quick, then return your face smoothly.
- Practice holding the pool edge: face in, bubbles out, turn
